text:
incident-bot: Pager: sudden spike of GPU ENOMEM errors on decode-stream cluster (decode-prod-eu-central). 17 errors in 6m. Paging maya_oncall.

maya_oncall: I'm on it. seeing customer-facing 502/500s for streaming endpoints. which nodes?

sre_kim: collecting logs now. initial grep shows repeated "CUDA error: out of memory" during decode loop, followed by container OOM kill. stack shows token loop never exits when max_tokens header is "null" (string).

infra_omar: affected node nodes/gpu-euc-12 shows GPU mem at 98% then oom. k8s reported eviction with reason: "OutOfMemory". kernel logs attached.

eng_taylor: interesting: telemetry shows a small client (app_id=lumenai) sent max_tokens:"null" in JSON body due to a bad iOS SDK serialization bug. runtime code was treating non-numeric as missing and entering the streaming fallback that doesn't enforce a cap.

maya_oncall: can we short-circuit at the API gateway to protect the pool?

sre_kim: yes. two immediate mitigations: 1) at edge reject or coerce max_tokens that are not integer -> set to 256; 2) throttle per-client token rate for lumenai to 10 tok/s and max 1024 tokens per request. I'll push both rules.

incident-bot: Edge rule change job started: edge-rules/validate-max-tokens (deploy d-edge-2026-11-2).

infra_omar: cordoning node gpu-euc-12 and draining pods now. evicting 8 pods, creating pod replacements on healthy nodes.

eng_taylor: runtime patch: add explicit parse guard for max_tokens and enforce cap=1024 for legacy clients; adding defensive guard to break streaming loop after 1024 tokens. will roll to decode-prod-eu-central.

support_noah: lumenai support ticket (TICKET-2245) shows many dropped streams. notifying them of mitigation and asking for release of patched iOS SDK.

incident-bot: edge-rules/validate-max-tokens rolled to 100% in region eu-central.

sre_kim: after edge rule, new OOMs dropped to near zero. existing leaked processes still consume memory until restarted.

infra_omar: drained gpu-euc-12 completed. replacement pods healthy on nodes gpu-euc-08/09. no further restarts.

eng_taylor: runtime hotfix deployed. verified with synthetic test: send max_tokens:"null" -> gateway coerces to 256, runtime clamps to 256 when client not opted-in. streaming terminates at cap. added unit/regression tests.

maya_oncall: monitoring metrics: decode-pool ENOMEM count down 95%, 502 rate down to baseline.

support_noah: sent customer update to lumenai: interim mitigation active, SDK patch requested, we'll follow up with postmortem.

pm_leah: drafting PS communication for affected customers. include impacted window and mitigation steps.

cs_ari: lumenai confirms they were on iOS SDK 1.9.0-beta and passing null. they appreciate quick response and requested timeline for permanent fix.

eng_taylor: follow-ups: 1) ship SDK fix to serialize max_tokens as integer by default (eng ticket SDK-789); 2) add server-side opt-out flag for customers that require legacy behavior; 3) create alert for non-integer max_tokens occurrences.

sre_kim: post-incident actions: add decode-pool mem spike dashboard, instrument per-request token count telemetry, add runtime guard to kill stream after 2048 tokens absolute.

infra_omar: suggest kube pod termination grace increase to let streaming loops exit cleanly on drain, and tweak eviction window to avoid tight crash-restart cycles. filing PR.

incident-bot: Incident severity set to Sev2 -> downgraded to Sev3 after mitigation; owner: maya_oncall.

maya_oncall: good work. please drop PRs and runbook updates here. leaving the thread open for postmortem notes.

eng_taylor: PRs: runtime hotfix: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/4991 (parse-guard + token-clamp), edge rule PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/edge-config/pull/284 (validate-max-tokens), infra PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/207 (kube-eviction-tuning).

sre_kim: added alert rule: non_integer_max_tokens > 5/min -> page.

pm_leah: CS update sent to customers list; post-incident review scheduled 14:00 UTC.

cs_ari: lumenai will hold off update until SDK fix is published and asked for a follow-up call.

maya_oncall: ops checklist: monitor for 30m no-oom, merge and rollout runtime PR, update decode runbook with streaming token fail-safes. closing after watch window.

incident-bot: Watch window started.
